sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI 推出 Images 2.6，官方称全球每周经 ChatGPT、Codex 和 API 生成 40 亿张图、日超 5 亿张，新版提速约 50%，支持 GIF 并强化多轮编辑一致性。

en.title: From drawing to editing: OpenAI rounds out its image generation workflow with Images 2.6
en.reason: OpenAI's Images 2.6 targets editing workflows with roughly 50% faster generation, GIF support and stronger multi-turn consistency, as users create 4 billion images weekly across ChatGPT, Codex and the API—over 500 million daily.
